summary: HSPnetPage provides the foundational class and behaviors for web pages in the HSPnet application, including session validation, locale handling, asset and script injection, Google Analytics, session timeout warning logic, error/warning management, footer composition, and navigation setup.
purpose: To standardize and control the initialization, session management, asset loading, culture/locale settings, error/warning display, navigation, and session timeout warnings for all HSPnet web pages.

workflows.name: Session Management and Time-Out Warning
steps: On page load, initialize session and check its validity.
If session invalid, redirect to Timedout.aspx.
Set up session time-out warning: inject JS dialog that counts down seconds, shows warning, allows session reset or closure.
Use AJAX calls to /WebServices/ManageSession.asmx/CheckSession or /ResetSession based on user action.
Update UI to show remaining session time and warning dialog.
Clear all intervals and timers as needed.

workflows.name: Culture/Locale Initialization
steps: Locale is retrieved from query string or database.
If none is found, use default locale.
Sets thread culture and date formats based on locale and resources.
Allows for override of date format per HSPnet standards.

workflows.name: Asset Injection
steps: Inject necessary CSS and JS assets (including jQuery, custom scripts, Google Analytics, etc.) into page header.
Add Google Analytics script if tracking ID is provided.
Ensure asset loading order to prevent JS errors.

workflows.name: Navigation Setup
steps: Build left navigation via HSPnet.Framework.LeftNavigation.
Restore navigation tree state based on cookies.
Set startup screen and make start page panel visible.

workflows.name: Page Error/Warning Handling
steps: Gather errors and warnings from UserSession.Messages.
Display errors and warnings via panels with scrollable containers.
Adjust warning panel offset if errors are present to avoid UI conflicts.
Register JavaScript client IDs for panels.

workflows.name: Footer Generation
steps: Compose footer with copyright, version, user info, agency/department, login time, time zone, and page load time.

business_rules: Session must be valid on every page load; otherwise user is redirected.
Locale must be valid; if not, fallback to default.
Session time-out warning only shown if enabled in session settings.
Asset loading must occur in proper order to prevent JS errors.
Certain pages (e.g., Default.aspx, ForgotPassword.aspx) skip session timeout logic.
Navigation expanded state restored via cookies.
validations: URL hash validated for security (except login page).
Session validity checked in HSPnetSession.IsValid(Request, Response).
Errors/warnings panels shown only if messages exist.
Session hash format checked before AJAX calls.
calculations: Session warning and refresh intervals calculated from session settings.
Vertical offset for warning panel determined by number of errors.
Footer includes load time (seconds and milliseconds) calculated from start and end time.
conditions: If UserSession useTimeOutWarning is true, enable timeout warning.
If session hash is null, skip AJAX session check.
If Master.LoggingOut.Value equals '1', set session as logging out.
If locale is not found or invalid, fallback to default.
system_behavior: Injects assets and scripts dynamically based on settings.
Manages session state and redirects when necessary.
Displays session timeout warnings and handles user actions.
Handles error/warning display and UI adjustment.
exceptions: Session invalid or expired → redirect to Timedout.aspx.
AJAX errors handled via console logging.
Missing tracking ID for Google Analytics → skip injection.
